To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the IHMM is more appropriate than the HMM for modeling and analyzing the default data in a given sector, and that the BET modulated the IHMM is better than the BET modulated HMM for modeling the default data of bonds issued by the firms in the given sector.

the IHMM modulated BET is more suitable to capture the feedback effect of defaults on the risk state of the sector than the HMM modulated BET and the estimation results for both the IHMM modulate BET and the HMM modulate BET are reasonable.

we have proposed an interactive hidden Markova model (IHMM), which is more suitable for modeling default data than the traditional hidden Markov model, and we have developed an estimation method for the IHMM-modulate binomial expansion technique, which is more suitable than the HMM-modulate binomal expansion technique.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing an interactive hidden Markow model (IHMM), which is more realistic than the traditional hidden Markov model in modeling and analyzing default risk data.
modeling default data using the IHMM modulated by the BET, which seems to be more flexible and realistic than the traditional HMM modulated by BET.

the following three issues: (i) the use of an IHMM for modeling and analyzing defaults data in a sector; (ii) the use of the IHMM-modulation to the BET for modeling the default data in a market, and (iii) the comparison between the IHMM-modified BET and the BET modified by the HMM in terms of modeling the defaults in a market.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the BET modulated with the IHMM provides a better model of default data than the BET modulated HMM.
the feedback effect is significant and should not be ignored in modeling default data.
the IHMM-modulation of the BET provides a better fit to the data than the HMM-modulation of it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the BET modulated with the IHMM is more realistic than the BET modulated HMM and it is more flexible than the IHMM in the sense that it allows the number of defaults in the sector to be a random variable.
the feedback effect of defaults on the risk state of the sector should be taken into account in order to model and analyze default data.
we propose to use the IHMM for default modeling and the BET modulated IHMM for modeling default data in a given sector, which incorporates the feedback effect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the feedback effect is significant and should not be ignored when modeling and analyzing default time series data.
the feedback effect of defaults on transitions of the hidden states is significant in modeling the default data.
the IHMM-modulation is more appropriate than the HMM-modulation when there is feedback effect.
